components.problem: Iteration-1 significance ceiling was the [simulated] regime. Iteration-2 question: does exact torus spectral KRR on REAL NOAA Kaplan SST v2 monthly anomaly fields (1856-2023, 36x72 5-deg grid, 2005 months; Nino3.4 index validated vs 1982/83, 1997/98, 2015/16 El Nino and 1988/89 La Nina) (a) reconstruct masked real fields with calibrated diagnostic intervals and (b) forecast the real Nino3.4 index at horizons h in {1,3,6,12} against persistence/climatology/AR(1), under a future-blind temporal holdout with leakage verification? EXPECTED-RESULTS CEILING (stated): no SOTA-ENSO-skill claim, no FFT-kernel/spectral-regression newness claim. The significance target is a SPECIFIC METHODOLOGICAL PACKAGE: real-data replication that converts the iteration-1 simulated-only result into an executed, reproducible benchmark, plus a leakage-verified future-blind evaluation protocol (temporal-block conformal diagnostics, seam-leakage sensitivity, year-block bootstrap significance) for exact spectral kernel methods on real climate grids.
components.method: (1) Core: exact torus spectral KRR (BCCB closed-form solve; spectral floor disclosed; exactness verified vs dense floored reference; free-boundary gap measured; masked-input PCG with exact free-boundary BTTB matvec). (2) ONE consistent spectral functional operator: box mean = spectral inner product with the box indicator (Parseval/linearity); identical operator for the reconstruction functional and the forecast index; commutes with the FFT machinery by linearity. (3) Transfer forecast (extension, honestly scoped): per-Fourier-mode ridge H_h (train-only modes), index forecast = spectral functional of the transfer-filtered spectrum. (4) LEAK CONTROL normative + VERIFIED: every fit (climatology, AR(1), H_h and ridge lam_h, kernel spectra) train-only (<= 2015-12); rolling-origin evaluation; circulant wrap is SPATIAL-ONLY -- no temporal wrap at the 2015-12/2016-01 seam (verified by construction; seams tested via the sensitivity check below); masked cells never enter training or error/coverage evaluation (verified by construction); the 2015/16 El Nino PEAK (Dec 2015) is acknowledged INSIDE the train window, so only the event's decaying phase is test-side.
components.experiment_design: Data: real Kaplan v2 (results/raw/real/). Split: train <= 2015-12 (1920 months), test 2016-01..2022-12 (84 months); hyperparameters via temporal-block CV inside train; mask ratio FIXED and mirrored across folds and test; mirrored-mask construction: masks and their reflections are applied to ocean cells only, defined once for the WHOLE run (not reset per rolling origin); the same mask schedule is used in the temporal-block CV inside train; masked cells NEVER appear in training or in error/coverage evaluation (verified by construction). ARM DEFINITIONS (one line each): P0 = pilot exactness gate vs dense floored reference on real fields; T1a = masked-cell reconstruction (random 10/30/50% + halo w1/2/4, LOFO months, RMSE + skill vs train-only monthly climatology on held-out cells only); T1b = masked-input exact-free PCG (10/30/50% inputs, RMSE on masked cells); T2 = functional index regression (spectral box functional, temporal-block CV, vs zero-model = train box mean and vs direct RBF head); T3 = forecast horizons h in {1,3,6,12} ONLY (intermediate horizons are NOT evaluated and NOT interpolated; spectral transfer vs persistence, train-only monthly climatology, train-only AR(1); per-h RMSE/MAE/corr + climatology skill; SIGNIFICANCE: year-block bootstrap PRIMARY (preferred in this non-exchangeable rolling-origin setting), Diebold-Mariano reported secondary); B = sklearn exact-subsample/Nystrom/RFF on real pooled cells; S = scaling (unchanged). CONFORMAL (non-exchangeable, acknowledged): conformity score = absolute residual per held-out masked cell; calibration set = the 5 temporal blocks immediately preceding the test window; the conformal threshold is REFIT at each rolling origin; calibration blocks are strictly AFTER and NON-OVERLAPPING with the H_h training blocks (calibration-leak independence explicit); coverage reported as DIAGNOSTIC per mask aggregated spatially (per field) and per fold temporally, with mean width. SEAM-LEAKAGE SENSITIVITY CHECK: report h=1 skill under '2015 excluded from train' vs '2015 retained in train' (one-year origin shift) -- stable skill = leak-free seam (sensitivity, not p-value). DECAY-PHASE SENSITIVITY: report the 2016 test months with and without (decay-phase-confound check for the in-train 2015/16 peak). BUDGET (worst case, total): P0 ~0.5 s; T1a ~2 s; T1b ~10 s; T2 ~3 s; T3 = 4 horizons x ~2000 rolling origins x 2 FFTs(36x72) ~1 s; B ~60 s; S ~1 s; data load ~2 s; TOTAL < 90 s CPU (well under the 90-min cap; peak RSS << 7 GB). WALL-CLOCK PROTOCOL: per-arm wall_clock_s = MEDIAN of 3 runs after a single warm-up call, single machine state (12 cores); the <90-min budget claim uses worst-case (max) estimates. All artifacts carry dataset.origin=real-kaplan-sst-v2.
components.revision_note: Round-2 reviewer feedback closed: h-alignment (problem {1,3,6,12} = T3 set); conformal threshold refit per rolling origin + calibration blocks non-overlapping with H_h training blocks; 2015/16 El Nino peak-in-train acknowledged + decay-phase sensitivity; mirrored-mask construction (ocean-only, reflection, defined once, same schedule in CV); fixed mask not reset per origin; wall-clock protocol (median of 3, warm-up, worst-case budget claim).
